name: A/B Test
description: Two-proportion z-test with power and required sample size, aggregated in SQL (the rows are never read into the JVM). The two levels of group are ordered lexicographically: the first is the control, the second the treatment. One output row: control_rate, treatment_rate, lift (relative, treatment/control - 1), z_statistic (pooled two-proportion z), p_value (two-sided normal tail), power (achieved power for the observed effect and group sizes), required_n_per_group (Fleiss formula for the design effect: mde relative lift or the observed lift, control rate baseline or the observed control rate), mde (the lift used) and alpha.

group.title: Group column
group.description: Categorical column with exactly two levels: the first in lexicographic order is the control, the second the treatment.

alpha.title: Significance level
alpha.description: Two-sided significance level of the test and the power formulas.

power.title: Target power
power.description: Target power of the required sample size formula, in (0, 1).

mde.title: Minimum detectable effect
mde.description: Relative lift used for required_n_per_group; when omitted the observed lift is used.

baseline.title: Baseline rate
baseline.description: Control rate used for required_n_per_group; when omitted the observed control rate is used.
